key_insight: MedGame turns static clinical cases into structured storytelling games using LLMs to guide learners through decision-centered medical scenarios.
clinical_relevance: It may make medical education more engaging and interactive than text-only case practice, helping students explore clinical decision-making in a guided format.
method: Built a dual-engine system: a Medical Narrative Designer for case-grounded storylines and decision nodes.
Added a Story Director to generate dependency-aware multimodal orchestration plans for an interactive platform.
Created MedGame Bench with 5,000 cases to evaluate medical narrative generation and story direction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that fine-tuning improved open-source LLMs on MedGame Bench, reduced the gap with commercial models, and a pilot student study found higher engagement and usefulness versus text-only alternatives.
watch_item: The pilot study and benchmark results suggest promise, but real-world educational impact and robustness across diverse clinical domains still need broader validation.
paper_title: MedGame: Storytelling Gamification Empowered by Large Language Models for Medical Education
